stdout:
needs-a-human: the reported pre-super field-write failure is supported by the enhancement code, but a correct receiver-aware constructor strategy needs design review before implementation.

Exploration is pinned to official main 1ed820d01410071e52430eca4ad129b9eaf3e844. No code was changed and no compilation or runtime reproduction was performed.

Both [PersistentAttributeTransformer](https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-orm/blob/1ed820d01410071e52430eca4ad129b9eaf3e844/hibernate-core/src/main/java/org/hibernate/bytecode/enhance/internal/bytebuddy/PersistentAttributeTransformer.java) and [FieldAccessEnhancer](https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-orm/blob/1ed820d01410071e52430eca4ad129b9eaf3e844/hibernate-core/src/main/java/org/hibernate/bytecode/enhance/internal/bytebuddy/FieldAccessEnhancer.java) replace eligible PUTFIELD instructions with virtual writer calls. Their field visitors do not distinguish an uninitialized constructor receiver.

The blast radius includes ordinary and extended enhancement, constructor chaining and field interception. Two-way: an internal visitor change is reversible and need not change public API or persisted formats, but incorrect initialization tracking can make otherwise valid classes unverifiable.

A first-constructor-call flag is insufficient: constructor arguments may instantiate another object before this object's superclass call. Skipping every constructor or every early field write would also suppress legitimate interception of initialized receivers.

Decision required: choose a proven receiver-aware tracking mechanism, with clear dependency and bytecode-coverage boundaries, before assigning implementation. Preserve writes to uninitializedThis while retaining interception for initialized other objects and post-initialization writes.

Required RED/GREEN coverage: a Java 25 pre-super persistent-field assignment that fails class verification on the baseline, matching value preservation after enhancement, ordinary constructors, this/super chaining, nested object construction before super, and both normal/extended enhancement. Use focused Actions and exact-head verification.

Jira was New, unassigned and unresolved on October 22; exact and semantic searches found no competing fix. The batch contains only #28, with no duplicate to close.

Patterns: Constructor-sensitive field enhancement must distinguish the actual receiver's initialization state; opcode or method-name matching alone is insufficient.

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>
